title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore West on 1970-02-05
lineage: SBD MR > C > D > CD + AUD low-gen

ai_review.summary: Good‑to‑excellent matrix recording of a 2/5/70 Fillmore West show, highlighted by a smoking Mason’s Children, The Eleven → Caution sequence and tight drumming.
ai_review.review: The tape is a blend of soundboard and audience sources; the bulk of the second half is crystal‑clear SBD while the opening four tracks are lo‑fi crowd recordings.  Listeners repeatedly praise the performance – especially Mason’s Children, The Eleven into Caution, and the punchy drum work – despite some muddy spots, low bass in the mix and occasional pitch issues on the audience cuts.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers give 4‑5 stars and extol the musical highlights; technical flaws are noted but do not dominate, yielding an overall strong rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: First four tracks are audience recordings (acceptable for a 1970 tape). The majority of the show is soundboard with clear detail, though some SBD sections are described as muddy or low‑bass. A few AUD fragments at the end are noisy; pitch speed issues on Black Peter noted by one reviewer. Overall listenable.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Reviewers highlight a strong, flowing set – the classic Eleven→Caution transition and an energetic second half.  Missing or mis‑listed early acoustic numbers cause some confusion, but the musical arc is praised as magical and tightly knit.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Garcia’s guitar tone is frequently praised; a brief 'new Speedway Boogie' jam inside Big Boss Man is noted as an adventurous moment.
band_member_comments.Phil: Phil Lesh’s bass work shines on Mason’s Children (second instrumental) and his insistent riff in Caution receives special mention.
band_member_comments.Keys: Pigpen’s organ contribution on The Eleven is highlighted as a rare, emotional highlight for the period.
band_member_comments.Drums: The drum sound gets repeated accolades – described as popping, crunchy, bright, and well‑mixed, especially during Mason’s Children and the Eleven jam.
